title: Account lifecycle delete
human_promise: I can recover, delete, and control my account data.
entry_state: User starts signed out, can recover password, register with disposable credentials, and reach authenticated privacy controls.
account_state: Signed out at recovery/register entry, authenticated before privacy control, signed out again after account deletion.
success_state: Recovery entry, registration, profile seal, privacy control, account deletion, and post-delete signed-out state all replay in one runtime proof.
negative_assertions: Deleted account cannot keep an authenticated privacy surface visible.
Email verification interstitial must not block the tested disposable staging account.
Privacy delete controls must not remain visible after deletion.

priority.rationale: Only T0 seed with missing evidence; account recovery/delete/control is a trust and release boundary.

evidence.reason: PR #740 proves the authenticated /profile/privacy deletion entry opens confirmation, calls AuthProvider.deleteAccount(), and redirects home on success.

evidence.command: MAESTRO_HARD_LIMIT=360 MAESTRO_STALL_THRESHOLD=90 MINT_WALKER_ARTIFACTS=.planning/runtime-evidence/jos001-account-lifecycle-20260626T200541Z bash tools/simulator/maestro_with_watchdog.sh test --format junit --output .planning/runtime-evidence/jos001-account-lifecycle-20260626T200541Z/result.xml --env MINT_E2E_EMAIL=<fresh disposable e2e email> --env MINT_E2E_PASSWORD=<redacted> tools/simulator/flows/maestro-perfect-set/flow_jos001_account_lifecycle_seeded_delete.yaml
evidence.reason: Runtime proof drives recovery entry, POST /api/v1/auth/register, onboarding profile seal, privacy controls, privacy center delete confirmation, DELETE /api/v1/auth/account, and post-delete signed-out recovery state.
